an4.213:1.1: catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.213:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ nirayeti.
an4.213:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.213:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
